name: rietx.schemas.instrument.Geometry:bounds
decides: Default boxes: sample_displacement +-1 mm, capillary offsets +-1 mm, sample_transparency [0, 0.05], axial_sl and axial_hl [0, 0.2]; all start at 0 and are held.
evidence: WP-1311: +-1 mm is 'a runaway guard, not a physical limit', 20x loose against a packed plate (|s| < 0.05 mm); kept since v0.2 to avoid a user-facing break
provenance: WP-1311 (measured 2026-09-18, one table of FWHM multiples on 100-300 mm goniometers); 11-BM on 1073's zero/displacement degeneracy riding to a bound while Rwp improves and the cell moves 1117 ppm.
families: APS 11-BM (WP-1073): the failure a bound would catch
laboratory goniometer table (arithmetic, not a dataset)
failure_case: At the bound a line moves 0.19-1.13 deg, 0.9-14x a typical FWHM; one mm spans 3.0x across 100-300 mm radii.
judgement: none stated by the record; the maintainer's ruling kept it on the 'keep and document' precedent. A refiner on a 300 mm goniometer gets 0.27 deg of licence, on 100 mm 0.57 deg.
note: Hold-by-default (vary False), so inert until freed.

name: rietx.schemas.instrument.EmissionLine:weight
decides: Default relative line weight 1.0 in [0, 2]; presets seed the Ka2 weight at ka2_ratio in [0, 1].
evidence: no source stated for the box; line 0 is locked at 1 by convention, so the box governs the other lines only
provenance: no WP; instrument.py:2545 and :2596 repeat the [0, 1] and [0, 2] boxes
failure_case: none stated
judgement: none: Ka2/Ka1 is 0.5 by 2j+1 degeneracy; a weight above 2 is not an emission line.

name: rietx.schemas.instrument.Instrument.bragg_brentano:goniometer_radius_mm
decides: Preset default goniometer radius 217.5 mm, which converts a refined displacement in mm to an angle.
evidence: no source stated; 217.5 mm is the Bruker D8 Advance standard radius (recalled)
provenance: none: no WP or dataset states 217.5 mm (grep docs/wp 2026-10-19)
failure_case: none stated
judgement: A Panalytical user (240 mm) or a 150 mm bench gets sample_displacement in mm wrong by the radius ratio; the 2theta shift fitted is the same, so the angle is right and the mm value is off. The caller states the radius.
note: The bragg_brentano validator refuses a missing radius, so this default exists to stop the refusal. 'Instrument.bragg_brentano' is not on DEFAULT_SEATS.

name: rietx.schemas.instrument.Instrument.bragg_brentano:ka2_ratio
decides: Preset seed 0.5 of the refinable Ka2/Ka1 weight, box [0, 1].
evidence: physics: 2j+1 degeneracy ratio 4:2 = 0.5, right for every anode; measured ratios run a few percent above and a monochromator passband clips it (docstring)
judgement: none: a seed, refined from the data.

name: rietx.schemas.instrument.Instrument.debye_scherrer:polarization
decides: Preset default K = 0.99 for the capillary/synchrotron preset.
evidence: APS 11-BM instrument-parameter files (docstring, GSAS POLA convention); one facility
provenance: docstring only: 'matches APS 11-BM instrument-parameter files'
families: APS 11-BM: one facility, no failure stated
failure_case: none stated
judgement: A lab-capillary user (a Cu tube, K near 0.5 to 0.8 depending on the monochromator) would choose otherwise; the preset name says 'synchrotron/capillary' and the Kbeta/polarization correlate with other terms.
note: Presets differ: bragg_brentano computes K from the monochromator angle, debye_scherrer assumes a synchrotron. A wrong K moved a refined Biso by 12 sigma (WP-1311 item 2).

name: rietx.schemas.instrument.Geometry:packing_fraction
decides: Estimator input 0.6 for the powder packing fraction that feeds mu_R or mu_t when only a radius or thickness is declared.
evidence: docstring: 0.3-0.6 typical for a tapped powder, 0.64 random close packing of spheres; no measurement
provenance: none: docstring ranges only (0.3-0.6 typical, 0.64 random close packing); no WP or dataset
failure_case: none stated
judgement: A caller with a loosely packed or densified specimen would choose otherwise; mu_r itself can be declared and then this is not read.
note: Only read when mu_r (or mu_t) is None and capillary_radius_mm (thickness_mm) is declared, so it is an opt-in estimate.

name: rietx.schemas.structure.Atom:occ
decides: Default occupancy 1.0, held, in [0, 1.5]; a caller's Parameter inherits the box where it states none.
evidence: no source stated for 1.5; 'site fractions in [0, 1]' is the module docstring, so the ceiling departs from it; issue #204/PR #206 made the box bind
provenance: PR #206 / issue #204 (the inheritance rule); no record gives 1.5
failure_case: none stated
judgement: A caller using occupancy to absorb a multiplicity or scale error above 1.5 would choose otherwise; GSAS-II, FullProf and TOPAS set no default occupancy bound (practice recalled, GSAS-II controls checked in WP-1110 for cell only).
note: The same box is spelled in six places: Atom.occ (structure.py:500), crystallography/cif.py:775, io/recipe.py:1079, io/projects/{fullprof.py:2848, gsas.py:1609, gsas2.py:1818}. A sibling defect class: one number, six spellings, no shared constant.

name: rietx.schemas.structure.Atom:biso
decides: Starting value 0.5 A^2 and no bounds, held, for an atom built without a Biso.
evidence: no source stated; unbounded by WP-1534's ruling (2026-10-04) as in FullProf, TOPAS and GSAS-II
provenance: WP-1534 removed the 0-25 A^2 box; the starting value has no WP.
failure_case: Issue #204: an unbounded Biso walked a scale-B ridge to -165 A^2 and returned two phase fractions at one Rwp; the answer was the WP-1534 hold plus BISO_NEGATIVE and BISO_UNUSUALLY_LARGE.
judgement: none: any start in 0.1-5 A^2 reaches the same B when the data constrain it (inferred, not measured); a CIF read overrides it.
note: WP-1311 and viz/compare.py (min 0, max 25) still say 0-25 A^2; params/vector.py:1032 (tie_window docstring) says 'Biso in [0, 25]'. Stale text, not stale behaviour.

name: rietx.schemas.structure.Phase:off_state_defaults
decides: Off or identity defaults: scale 1.0 (held), extinction 0, the eight size and strain widths 0 (all min 0), moment components 0, restraint weight 1.0, aniso U off-diagonals 0.
evidence: arithmetic: each default is the exact off or identity state (zero width, E = 1, weight 1), pinned by bit-identity tests; the scale is seeded by the plans
judgement: none: no claim made.
note: min=0 is safe wherever zero is the off state (WP-1028 (e) audit: r is the only softplus parameter with an interior identity).

name: rietx.schemas.instrument.Geometry:kind
decides: A Geometry or Instrument built without a kind is a debye_scherrer capillary.
without: The position-correction family (sin 2theta capillary offset vs flat-plate transparency) and the absorption branch (mu_R vs mu_t) follow the kind, so a flat-plate user gets the capillary family
evidence: no source stated; present since the v0.2 schema; the presets set the kind explicitly
provenance: none: no WP states the default; v0.2 schema (WP-1311 cites commit 473cc5a7 for the sibling bounds)
failure_case: none stated
judgement: A laboratory Bragg-Brentano user who builds Instrument(source=...) and so inherits a capillary geometry would choose otherwise; bragg_brentano refuses a missing goniometer radius, but the default kind does not. The report layer keys its position actions by Geometry.kind (report/layer1.POSITION_TEMPLATES), so the wrong default yields wrong suggestions silently.
note: Specimen geometry is a fact outside the pattern (kind 3). Not on DEFAULT_SEATS. A required argument would be the demotion; the lead may judge it too cheap to ask.

name: rietx.schemas.instrument.BackgroundPSpline:lambda_smooth
decides: Default P-spline smoothness weight 1.0 (dimensionless, relative to the data's weight per coefficient); auto_background passes it too (background/auto.py:118).
without: A background free to imitate Bragg peaks: ADPs biased up and scales down while Rwp improves (BACKGROUND_ABSORPTION)
evidence: WP-1454: derived (lambda = 1 suppresses features narrower than a knot spacing); flat from 0.1 to 100 on IUCr sample 2 and NAC
provenance: WP-1454: 11-BM NAC (old default measured 0.01-0.1 in the new units) and IUCr round-robin sample 2 (lambda 0.01 to 100: Rwp 0.12205-0.12412, B Al 0.346-0.353; absorption flag only at 0.01); a private high-count series needed ~10^4 stiffer.
families: APS 11-BM NAC (one laboratory and instrument): verifies
IUCr QPA round robin sample 2 (laboratory XRD): verifies, weighed composition not used here
a private high-count series: the failure case
failure_case: The private series, at high counts, was 10^4-fold stiffer than 1.0; 'the too-stiff side has no guard' (root CLAUDE.md, Background flexibility).
judgement: A user with a background feature narrower than the knot spacing (an amorphous hump) or very high counts would choose otherwise; 'intensity' units and a declared lambda are the way out, and BACKGROUND_ABSORPTION reports the flexible side.
note: Reader B owns auto_background's own rows. The knot_step_deg = 5.0 default of for_range (instrument.py:1592) is the sibling number, with no source found.

name: rietx.schemas.structure.PreferredOrientation._r_bound_is_reachable
decides: A stored March-Dollase r lower bound at or under 1e-12 is raised to MARCH_R_MIN, and the value with it, silently.
without: A project or history node stored before WP-1938 carries min 0 and grinds its budget on NaN
evidence: physics: the March factor divides by r, so r = 0 is a pole (inf/NaN, a stage that did not return in ten minutes); the repair lifts a bound onto the real floor
judgement: none: every competent refiner lifts a bound sitting on a pole. The record's rule (a silent correction is a reader's to make) is met only in part: the schema has no diagnostics channel, so nothing reports it.
note: Always on, no record field: the DESIGN rule 4 'records that it fired' is not met. Siblings with the same shape: ProfileTCHZ._w_floor_is_reachable (instrument.py:1444, W floor), and the HumpComponent and PeakComponent fwhm repairs (instrument.py:1960, :2125). The lead may want one record field or a note on the result.

name: rietx.schemas.instrument.ExtraComponent:fwhm_floor_repair
decides: A stored hump or peak fwhm lower bound at or under 1e-12 is raised to HUMP_FWHM_MIN or EXTRA_PEAK_FWHM_MIN, and the value with it, silently.
evidence: arithmetic: the pseudo-Voigt divides by the width, so zero is a pole; same pattern as the March r repair
judgement: none: as the March r repair. Silent, no record field.
note: Opt-in feature (extra_components), repair at instrument.py:1970-1976 and :2132-2137. ProfileTCHZ._w_floor_is_reachable (W under 1e-8, reader M's value) is the same shape.

name: rietx.params.vector.ParameterTable:aniso_symmetry_tolerance
decides: An anisotropic ADP tensor is refused when it differs from the nearest site-symmetry-allowed tensor by more than 1e-6 of its largest component (floor 1e-6).
without: A CIF tensor with U11 != U22 by 1e-5 on a tetragonal site would be refined as if exact, or silently symmetrised
evidence: no source stated; refusal tolerance rather than a symmetrisation (record: a tensor outside the allowed subspace raises)
provenance: no WP states 1e-6
failure_case: none stated
judgement: A caller with a CIF quoting U11 = 0.01230 and U22 = 0.01234 on a symmetry-equal pair would choose otherwise (symmetrise); the CIF reader's repair is the place, and a mismatch within 1e-6 of the largest component passes.
note: Same tolerance (1e-6) for microstrain at vector.py:1437. The 1e-9 literals at :1562, :1565, :2873, :3979, :3989 are lstsq-residual and rigid-body guards (WP-1803: stale anchor 2e-3 A against 1e-15 A) and are numerical floors, tier 1.

name: rietx.schemas.results.StageResult.held
decides: At stage start, holds every free structural column of a phase whose scale significance (screen, or the min with the previous stage's answer) is under PHASE_SUPPORT_SIGMA = 3; never its scale.
without: A phase the data cannot see refines its cell along a flat direction: the ramp's CaF2 cell ended 14.88 A off (cells of 20.3 A and -6.5 A, esds ~1e24) with Rwp unmoved, and the stage spends its budget there.
evidence: WP-1301/1523: a phase under 3 sigma of counting noise has its structure held; free, a cell walked 14.9 A at unchanged Rwp (v1.3 row)
provenance: WP-1301 (2026-08-28, the ramp table), WP-1523 (2026-10-13: marginal significance, the prior, 946->862 solves over 104 fits), WP-1342 (columns not names)
families: rietx simulated in-situ ramp, CaF2 onset (13 sub-onset patterns): validates (declared truth, phase absent below onset)
issue #481 blank frame + planted weak phases, 64 fits (synthetic): validates (planted truth)
IUCr CPD round robin cpd-1c (lab XRD, weighed mixture): validates silence (all phases present, nothing held in 8 stages)
NIST SRM 660c LaB6 fitted in 22.5-29.5 deg (no reflection in range): validates (certified line positions)
failure_case: WP-1523: a real phase at ~1/16 000 of a strong one's scale is mostly held (1 of 8 fits saw it; refined, its cell was up to 1000 ppm off); one weak real phase of 64 fits moved refined->held at 2.46 sigma; under solver='trf' a phase with no reflection in range walks its scale, which no hold touches.
judgement: none: no competent refiner lets a phase the data cannot see refine its cell (the record's own example). Only the 3 sigma threshold is on trial, and it is model.forward.PHASE_SUPPORT_SIGMA, another reader's row.
note: One record field carries three holds: the phase hold (this row), the moment hold (moment_flat_axes) and the scale-B ridge hold (scale_b_held) all append to held at refine.py:3962. The 3 sigma is a constant, not inline: rietx.model.forward.PHASE_SUPPORT_SIGMA = 3.0, held equal to indexing ABSENT_SIGMA by test (WP-1523). The hold also lifts itself at the next stage start (refine.py:3840).

name: rietx.schemas.results.StageResult.held_reach
decides: Records, per held column, the tied entries it also stopped (a vars.X's driven paths, b and c under a cubic a), read before the column leaves theta; the release and PHASE_UNCONSTRAINED find a held column's phase through it.
without: A held vars.X names no phase, so the release never lifted it: the 700 C CaF2 cell stayed at its 5.40 A seed against 5.463026 A released, Rwp 0.0550 -> 0.1939, no diagnostic (WP-1342).
evidence: WP-1342: the reach half of StageResult.held's hold; tiers with held
provenance: WP-1342 (columns, never names); the hold itself is WP-1301/1523
families: rietx simulated in-situ ramp, CaF2 onset (13 sub-onset patterns): validates (declared truth, phase absent below onset)
issue #481 blank frame + planted weak phases, 64 fits (synthetic): validates (planted truth)
IUCr CPD round robin cpd-1c (lab XRD, weighed mixture): validates silence (all phases present, nothing held in 8 stages)
NIST SRM 660c LaB6 fitted in 22.5-29.5 deg (no reflection in range): validates (certified line positions)
judgement: none: the same hold as StageResult.held; the reach is read off C's nonzero rows, which is arithmetic.
note: This is held's record rather than a separate action. The lead may prefer to move it to OTHER_RECORD_FIELDS and let held carry the tier.

name: rietx.schemas.results.StageResult.scale_b_held
where: src/rietx/refine.py:718 (_hold_scale_b_ridges; called :3961 and, for a phase released mid-stage, :4148)
decides: Holds a phase's displacement columns when the sine between its scale column and their span is under SCALE_B_SEPARATION_FLOOR (2*sqrt(PINV_RCOND) = 6.3e-8); never the scale; never released inside the stage.
without: Scale and B walk together along the ridge: bcc Fe to B = -165 A^2 on a 25-50 deg scan at an Rwp agreeing to 11 figures (#204); fluorite on 25-33 deg Cu Ka to B(Ca) +99, B(F) -111 A^2 and 0.0 wt% against 1.36 weighed.
evidence: numerical floor: under 2*sqrt(PINV_RCOND) the covariance's pinv cut cannot see scale and B as two directions (WP-1534 derivation); measured cases read 1e-12 or 0.19-0.40
judgement: none: below the pinv cut the pair is one direction to fp64, so B is not measurable and every refiner fixes it somewhere; holding it at the stage-start value is the smallest choice, and SCALE_B_INSEPARABLE names it.
note: If the lead reads the hold as rietx's design rather than a floor (tier 3), WP-1534's families are its four-phase fixture (bcc Fe, corundum, zincite, fluorite; synthetic), #204's bcc Fe 25-50 deg scan, and the qarr fluorite 25-33 deg case (weighed composition, validates). The derivation admits the real cut in a P-column matrix is up to sqrt(P/2) higher; a pair in that gap keeps its large esd and is not held.

name: rietx.schemas.results.StageResult.released
decides: At the answer, frees a held column whose phase now reads >= PHASE_SUPPORT_SIGMA, restores-and-holds the structure of a phase that fell under it while solving (to the stage-start values), and re-solves once, never twice.
without: A phase that appears mid-stage keeps its seed cell until the next stage; a phase that collapses while solving freezes its noise-chased cell (20.3 A and -6.5 A on the ramp, esd 1e24).
evidence: WP-1301/1523: release at >=3 sigma and collapse-restore under it, one extra solve; on the ramp the worst cell error fell from 11.96 A (start-only hold) to 0
provenance: WP-1301 (ramp arms: 2164 iterations/14.88 A unbounded, 1669/0 A shipped), WP-1523 (seed 107, the prior cut second solves 114 -> 30), WP-1342

name: rietx.schemas.results.StageResult.moment_flat_axes
where: src/rietx/refine.py:1096 (_hold_flat_moments), :955 (_flat_moment_scan), :813 (_flat_rotation_axis); stage start :3953, at the answer :4064-4103
decides: Holds a moment direction DOF (polar or azimuth, or the azimuth of a flat combination) when a 0.1 rad rotation both ways moves the pattern by <= MOMENT_DIRECTION_SUPPORT (1e-6) of the same tip displacement of the modulus; records the flat axis of a combination.

note: WP-1327 is in flight; read as the tree stands. The measured parts are thresholds: MOMENT_DIRECTION_SUPPORT (crystallography reader) and MOMENT_PROBE_ANGLE_RAD (this reader, tier 3). Rare feature: Cr2WO6 4 K (HB-2A) and LaMnO3 50 K (BT-1) real, cubic collinear and R-3m:R synthetic. Single-column holds land in held; this field records combinations only.

name: rietx.schemas.results.StageResult.moment_turned
decides: Turns a three-DOF moment about its flat axis onto the meridian through it (the point farther from the frame pole) before holding the azimuth, only if the turned moment reproduces the pattern to MOMENT_DIRECTION_SUPPORT.

evidence: issue #599 / review of #624: measured on synthetic R-3m:R (a = 4 A, alpha = 70 deg); the turn is checked unseen against MOMENT_DIRECTION_SUPPORT
provenance: WP-1327, issue #599, review of #624 item 1
families: synthetic R-3m:R, a = 4 A, alpha = 70 deg: verifies (constructed truth)
failure_case: A turn that does not reproduce the pattern to the floor is declined and the azimuth held where it is; a start at 3e-8 muB read roundoff both sides of the floor.
judgement: none on the measurement: the turn is a rotation the data cannot see, checked before it is written. The dissent is cosmetic: a refiner comparing with a published direction sees another representative of the same flat set, and only this field says why. A refiner choosing the frame with the unique axis as pole reaches the same family.
note: Rare feature with one synthetic family, so it is judged on the judgement ground alone (record § Where three families do not exist).

name: rietx.schemas.results.StageResult.moment_angle_tests
decides: After a solve with a free moment angle beside its free modulus, drives the angle columns to where they vanish; if delta-chi2 (others refitted linearly, over chi2_red*f^2) is within the 95 % chi-bar-squared cut, the angles' columns leave the covariance: values stand, no esd.
without: An angle at a symmetry-fixed direction keeps a column set by where the solver stopped, and that column sets the other esds: two-site Pnma moduli 0.031 and 0.159 muB against 0.00151 and 0.00111 with it left out.
evidence: WP-1929: chi-bar-squared cut (Self & Liang 1987; Shapiro 1985, docstring) at 95 %; measured on Cr2WO6 4 K and 150 K, LaMnO3 50 K, a synthetic two-site Pnma set
provenance: WP-1929 (2026-10-12; the linear refit matched the full refit's verdict on 96 fits)
families: Cr2WO6 4 K and 150 K null (HB-2A, ORNL HFIR): verifies (no certified moment)
LaMnO3 50 K (BT-1, NIST; GSAS-II Magnetic-I tutorial): verifies (tutorial answer)
two-site Pnma synthetic set: validates (constructed truth)
failure_case: A set whose Newton step does not reach the floor gets no statistic and keeps its columns; a linear-algebra failure leaves the columns in, as before WP-1929.
judgement: Passes in kind: an esd read off a column the symmetry makes vanish describes where the solver stopped, and the values stand. Contested in level: at 95 % one angle in twenty that is off the symmetric direction loses its esd. A refiner might instead refine the higher-symmetry model and compare by Hamilton's test, or quote the profile half-width this record carries.
note: Rare feature: two real neutron families, judged on the judgement ground alone. The 95 % is STATIONARY_ANGLE_LEVEL, the optimize reader's row. Ambiguity 2: a pick between two hypotheses at a conventional margin.

name: rietx.schemas.results.StageResult.n_constraint_truncations
decides: The default LM driver solves the step over the box and every linear-inequality row (sigma^2(M) >= 0; texture P >= 0 per reflection; Gamma_G^2 >= caglioti._MIN_GAMMA_G2) whenever the box-only step crosses a row, and counts it.
without: A step leaves the region where the model is defined: a negative Stephens variance under a square root, a negative pole density, or every Gaussian width column exactly zero so LM stops in place (WP-1938 D7).
evidence: physics: a strain variance and a pole density are non-negative (Stephens 1999; WP-1960 D4); numerical floor: Gamma_G^2 >= 1e-8 deg^2 keeps the width columns nonzero (WP-1938 D7)
judgement: none: outside the cone the model has no physical value. Under TRF, which cannot hold the rows, rietx reports STEPHENS_STRAIN_NOT_POSITIVE or TEXTURE_NOT_POSITIVE instead. GSAS-II does not constrain the Stephens coefficients (recalled, not checked).
note: The floor value is caglioti._MIN_GAMMA_G2 (model reader). With the cell free, the texture rows hold P >= 0 to first order only.
